card.text: Explore Dione in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Cassini and Voyager imagery and elevation maps of Saturn’s icy moon, its bright cliffs and fractured terrain.

introduction.text: An icy moon of Saturn with bright ice cliffs and long fractures crossing ancient cratered plains and smoother terrain. The shape view reveals a simplified Cassini SPC model. Relative albedo shows the model’s brightness variation; elevation uses its own stated reference sphere.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Detail varies across images from two missions. Photographed shadows remain; the gray grid marks missing observations.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal colors beyond human vision. The 2014 composite retains shading and seams.

elevation.title: SPC terrain model
elevation.summary: Color shows height above the PDS 561.4 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.58 km grid spacing. The globe uses a simplified version of the released Q128 shape; grid and geometry resolutions differ. Model detail and accuracy vary.

relative-albedo.title: SPC relative brightness model
relative-albedo.summary: Relative brightness solved together with the Cassini SPC shape model, normalized around 1. This secondary model product is less validated than topography. It is neither visible color nor calibrated reflectance. Colors show 0.5–1.5; values above 1.5 saturate. Gray grid preserves source gaps.

shape.title: SPC shape model
shape.summary: Neutral grid over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Cassini SPC Q128 model released in 2025. The 2,000-face view retains broad shape; small terrain details are omitted.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS infrared mosaic
infrared.summary: Photometrically corrected infrared spectra, shown as false color.

ice-absorption.title: Continuum-relative water-ice absorption; not ice abundance
ice-absorption.summary: Water-ice absorption strength, derived from the original spectra.
